title: Kompass: Germany today, neighbours & Europe
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Germany today, neighbours & Europe (1/2)
exercises.body: Modern Germany's ID card: full name **Bundesrepublik Deutschland**, ~**84 million** people ⏰, flag **schwarz-rot-gold**, borders final since **1990**, cash currency **Euro since 2002**. Know all **nine neighbors** (clockwise from the north): Dänemark, Polen, Tschechien, Österreich, Schweiz, Frankreich, Luxemburg, Belgien, Niederlande. BAMF asks "which is a neighbor" five separate times with rotating decoys.

exercises.title: Kompass: Germany today, neighbours & Europe (2/2)
exercises.body: The EU layer: born from the **Römische Verträge 1957** (EWG, six founders incl. Germany and its motive, peace through integration after two world wars), today **27 members** ⏰, Parliament elected every **5 years**, working in **Straßburg/Brüssel/Luxemburg**, **Schengen** = no internal border checks. Memory days: **27. Januar** (Auschwitz liberation. Holocaust remembrance day) and **3. Oktober** (unity).

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: Deutschland heute, Nachbarländer & Europa
exercises.body: Deutschland: 84 Mio. Einwohner, Flagge schwarz-rot-gold, 9 Nachbarländer. EU: 27 Staaten, Parlament in Straßburg/Brüssel/Luxemburg (Wahl alle 5 Jahre), Euro in bar seit 2002, Schengen = keine Passkontrollen. Anfang: Römische Verträge 1957 (EWG).
